v1Policy: Pari V1 performs no paraphraser fine-tuning or distillation. Dataset entries below are retained for external evaluation and post-V1 research only. V1 may use frozen evaluation sets and may benchmark existing pretrained/quantized models, but it must not train on any benchmark test split.

policy.post_v1_shipping_train: Potential source for post-V1 training of a shippable component, subject to source-level license/provenance audit and frozen holdouts.
policy.post_v1_research_train: May be used for post-V1 internal experiments but must not become a shipping dependency without further license/provenance review.
policy.eval_only: Frozen benchmark/reference material. Never train on it.
policy.blocked_pending_review: Do not use until licensing/provenance questions are resolved.

datasets.name: IteraTeR v2
datasets.provenance: human revision histories / iterative text revision
datasets.postV1Role: primary human-revision candidate if personalization/ranking data alone is insufficient
datasets.notes: Primary real human-revision source. Preserve official holdouts. Validate local-span extraction yield before using derived span pairs.

datasets.name: IteraTeR-FULL
datasets.license: apache-2.0 repository; audit source-level provenance before shipping training
datasets.provenance: revision histories across multiple writing domains
datasets.notes: Use only after overlap analysis against IteraTeR v2 so the same revisions are not double-counted.

datasets.name: CoEdIT public dataset
datasets.provenance: curated public text-editing datasets assembled for task-specific instruction tuning
datasets.v1Role: research reference only; no V1 training
datasets.notes: Public release excludes restricted simplification/formality examples. Audit constituent-source lineage before any shipping training decision. CoEdIT model checkpoints themselves are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and are research references only.

datasets.name: Smart Word Suggestions distant training data
datasets.license: MIT repository; verify dataset-specific terms in data package before shipping training
datasets.v1Role: none; V1 uses existing pretrained routes
datasets.notes: Weak supervision only. Never treat as gold. Post-V1 augmentation only after human-data and real-user preference baselines.

datasets.name: Smart Word Suggestions human test set
datasets.provenance: 1,000 English-learner sentences with >16k suggestions annotated by 10 native speakers
datasets.notes: Closest external benchmark to contextual click-to-change suggestions.

datasets.name: JFLEG
datasets.provenance: English learner sentences with four human fluency corrections
datasets.notes: Use official GLEU evaluation. Never train a shipping model on it.

datasets.name: ASSET
datasets.provenance: source sentences with multiple human simplifications
datasets.v1Role: route-specific validation only; not a universal model gate
datasets.notes: Use SARI plus independent meaning/safety checks.

datasets.name: PAWS-Wiki
datasets.license: dataset may be freely used for any purpose; acknowledgement requested
datasets.notes: Prefer as semantic-gate research/evaluation rather than rewrite-generation data.

datasets.name: WikiAtomicEdits
datasets.license: repository notes CC-BY-SA-4.0 for query-wellformedness and third-party content as-is; source-level audit required
datasets.provenance: ~43M atomic human Wikipedia insertions/deletions across 8 languages
datasets.notes: Potential post-V1 source for 1->many/many->1 behavior, but not a paraphrase-equivalence corpus. Must filter by intent/meaning and resolve licensing first.

datasets.name: EditEval
datasets.provenance: instruction-based text-improvement benchmark aggregating high-quality editing datasets
datasets.v1Role: external release validation by relevant task
datasets.notes: Report task-level results, not only aggregate.

datasets.name: WritingBench
datasets.provenance: 1,000 broad writing queries refined with human/domain-expert review and dynamic criteria
datasets.v1Role: model-family screening only; never V1 pass/fail
datasets.notes: Generation-from-prompt differs from conservative editing. Useful for spotting writer-specialized families, not for selecting the span editor.

datasets.name: PAR3
datasets.license: repository has a license file; source translations/public-domain alignment provenance requires detailed audit before training
datasets.provenance: multiple human English translations of public-domain foreign-language novels aligned at paragraph level
datasets.notes: Useful for post-V1 paragraph diversity research but literary-translation register differs sharply from normal student/professional prose. Do not make it the core training distribution.
